title: Frog Knight
move_pattern: Starts with Tongue Lash. Cycles through: Tongue Lash → Strike Down Evil → For the Queen. After For the Queen, if HP is below 50% and Beetle Charge hasn't been used yet, uses Beetle Charge (40 damage). Once Beetle Charge is used, it sets a flag preventing future use, and the pattern becomes: Tongue Lash → Strike Down Evil → For the Queen → Tongue Lash (repeating indefinitely).
notes: Frog Knight has conditional AI behavior based on health and a one-time Beetle Charge attack. The Beetle Charge is its most damaging move (40 damage) and serves as a threshold attack when the monster drops below 50% HP. Once used, it's gone for the remainder of the fight, forcing the enemy into a predictable three-move cycle.
